_comment: Reference values for lammps-polymer-setup. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-polymer-setup:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022).
_calibration_note: Oracle (snake-grid builder, seed 8675309) is deterministic: 5 runs identical, initial PE 21.743459, final PE 20.112237 after 3000 NVT steps. final_pe window [10, 30] deliberately wide: agent-built initial configurations legitimately differ (FENE-bond-dominated PE ~18-22/atom); the real gates are the topology/density checks, L4a (run-0 of polymer.data == log first line, tol 1e-3), evolution RMS >= 0.3, and L4b (run-0 of final.data == log last line, tol 1e-3).
